quarterly_data.signal: Customer UNISOC — 10-K customer concentration: sales to UNISOC (formerly Spreadtrum Communications) accounted for 15% of total revenues in both 2025 and 2024. Two royalty-paying customers (not named) each represented 10% or more of royalty revenues in 2025, together 39% (46% in 2024); the five largest royalty-paying customers accounted for 57% of 2025 royalty revenues versus 61% in 2024. Customers in China accounted for 62% of total revenues in 2025 versus 49% in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: UNISOC 15% of total revenues (2025 and 2024); top two royalty payers 39% of 2025 royalties; China 62% of 2025 revenues

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 revenue (10-K): total revenues $109.6 million (up 2.5%); licensing and related revenue $63.6 million (up 6%), royalty revenues $46.0 million (down 2%). By use case: Connect (baseband, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, NB-IoT) $81,935 thousand, 75% of revenue (versus $90,033 thousand and 84% in 2024); Sense & Infer (sensor fusion, audio, imaging, vision and AI) $27,663 thousand, 25% (versus $16,906 thousand and 16%); XBRL lists Smart Sensing Products $27.7M, +63.6% YoY. Unsatisfied licensing performance obligations (royalties excluded): $13,372 thousand expected in 2026, $1,523 thousand in 2027 and $483 thousand in 2028 and thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenues $109.6 million (up 2.5%); Sense & Infer $27,663 thousand (25% of revenue); licensing backlog $13,372 thousand for 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Licensee Microchip — 10-K: recent NPU agreements include Microchip's portfolio license for the NeuPro-M and NeuPro-Nano NPU families (generative and classic AI at the edge, embedded AI and TinyML).

Company claims (10-K): number one worldwide market share in wireless connectivity IP in 2024 with 68% global share; about 30% of worldwide Bluetooth IoT devices, about 50% of non-Apple TWS earbuds, about 40% of worldwide cellular IoT devices and about 30% of global 5G networks (RAN baseband processing) use its technology; licensees include seven of the world's top ten MCU vendors; MotionEngine software has shipped in more than 500 million devices; record Wi-Fi 6 shipments in 2025.
